confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from remembered Vienna price levels (2024-2025) carried forward to July 2026; no live listings or city-price searches were used. Restaurant and coffee anchors are moderately certain; hostel and hotel rates are least certain because July demand swings them. Beer assumes a 0.5 L draft. Cocktail and wine are set from beer levels and typical Viennese restaurant ratios. USD values rest on an unverified EUR/USD level near 1.16. The FX figure came from search-result summaries attributed to the RBA's 15 October 2026 4pm rate; the RBA page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city; anchored to Vienna's own remembered price levels, with loose relative-price reference to Munich and Prague and allowance for Vienna's high July hotel demand.
